name: LeaseManager

test_list.description: Under the production state mutex, overlapping waiters follow assigned ticket order; each receives one grant only after the preceding conflicting lease is released.
A blocked conflicting queue head does not prevent disjoint queued work, and try_acquire reports Busy rather than bypassing a conflicting active scope.

A blocked atomic multi-key waiter does not reserve unused active capacity from a disjoint immediate single-key request; try_acquire reports Busy with no active holder for the queued conflict, and the multi-key request is granted atomically when capacity becomes available.

inputs.name: bounded concurrent queue operations
inputs.description: Concurrent enqueue operations and actual production state-lock transitions using the feature-selected Loom mutex.

output_description: Checks conflicting FIFO, disjoint progress, atomic multi-key admission, and exactly-once release/grant accounting. Tokio notification delivery and ArcSwap behavior are outside this model.
